A bold wrapper holding only a newline-only span still separates the words on either side

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<b>Alpha</b><b><span>\n</span></b><b>Beta</b>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
